description:
A video and audio player which can play most formats and codecs.

QMPlay2 is a video and audio player. It can play all formats supported by FFmpeg, libmodplug (including J2B and SFX). It also supports Audio CD, raw files, Rayman 2 music and chiptunes. It contains YouTube and MyFreeMP3 browser.
- don't close panel when mouse is pressed inside window on full screen (regression fix),
- use BT.2020 surface for BT.2020 videos in Vulkan (enabled by default for Wayland),
- add support for BT.2020 TRC for sRGB conversion,
- display real gamma correction values,
- load and display LRC file contents,
- add option to hide QMPlay2 logo,
- fix HLG HDR display,
